title: fix(runtime)!: a signed-in caller is never admitted to an environment because the membership check could not read its session
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the environment-membership check (git grep over skills/ for the check, its error code and the member object: 0 hits)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:多环境部署中,环境成员检查对会话登录的请求改为按本次请求已解析出的身份(及其已核验的组织)判断,与 API Key、OAuth 两种凭据一致;检查所需的输入读不到时答 503,永不放行。
- 为什么改:已登录的调用方不应因为检查读不到它的会话就被放进它不是成员的环境。
- 风险与回滚:收紧方向。非成员得到 403 PROJECT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED,授权存储故障期间得到可重试的 503;匿名请求、系统环境、关闭检查的部署不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts(judgeEnvironmentMembership 开头的已解析身份分支,及拆出的 judgeMembershipOf)、packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-session-principal.test.ts、.changeset/environment-membership-session-principal-fail-closed.md
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher-membership-session-principal.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **a signed-in caller is never admitted because the environment-membership check could not read its session.** When the identity step admitted the request with a session, the check judges the principal the request resolved (`executionContext.userId`), in the organization its resolution vetted (`executionContext.tenantId`), exactly as it already judged an API-key or OAuth principal. An input the check still needs and cannot read is the outage (`AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`), never "allowed".

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`: `judgeEnvironmentMembership` judges any admitted principal (session, API key, OAuth) by the resolved envelope; only a request no credential admitted still reads the session, and when that read finds no principal upstream auth decides, as before. The verdict on one named principal (platform-organization pass, membership read, refusal) moves into `judgeMembershipOf`, unchanged. The declarative-endpoint step (`environmentMembershipRefusal`) shares the judgment, so the rule holds there too.
- Unchanged: anonymous requests, the well-known system environment, hosts with `enforceProjectMembership: false`, compositions that register no environment-member object, the API-key and OAuth arms, and the positive membership cache.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-read-principal-filtering.measurement.test.ts`: its boot registers no data engine and so holds no environment membership to judge; it now declares `enforceProjectMembership: false`. Its assertions are unchanged.
- `.changeset/environment-membership-session-principal-fail-closed.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime`, `!` summary, BREAKING paragraph with "Who moves", ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-session-principal.test.ts` (new, 10 cases, named by the rule):

- a signed-in non-member whose session the check cannot re-read is refused, naming the resolved principal;
- a signed-in non-member whose session re-read answers no session is refused, naming the resolved principal;
- a signed-in member whose session the check cannot re-read is judged as the resolved principal and passes;
- a member of the platform organization whose session cannot be re-read is judged in the organization its resolution vetted and passes;
- when the membership read cannot answer either, the signed-in caller is answered 503, never admitted;
- the declarative-endpoint step applies the same rule;
- CONTROL: a non-member whose session re-reads is refused, as before; an API-key principal is judged as the key's owner; a request with no resolved principal is not judged; the system environment stays open.

Existing membership suites (resolved principal, vetted organization, system context, skip boundary, the declarative-endpoint integration test) stay green unchanged.

**Ablation** (one-shot, not kept): with the rule removed from the committed fix, 5 of the 10 cases go red, the five the rule decides. The four CONTROL cases and the platform-organization case stay green; that last case passes on either tree; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to `HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR does not change the dispatcher's positive membership cache; that rule is with the owning seat.
- A request whose identity step recorded no principal (no credential admitted one) keeps the old path: the check reads the session, and with no principal found, upstream auth decides.
